_help: Spot the Spark scenes. who: me (the player) | crew (another crew member) | kid (another kid, else Pip) | grownup (a grown-up in the crew, else MC Sunny) | kiko | dash | pip | sunny. text: the caption, 8 words max; {name} is the character. bg: studio, street, park, rain, stage, backstage, home, rooftop. prop (optional): blocks, tablet, homework, puzzle, tree, drawing, keys, cereal, ball, lace, mic, boombox, trophy, flyer. side: which side the prop stands (left/right). cues: the order the clues appear — fists, stomp, cheeks, steam; always start with a subtle one (fists or cheeks) and end with steam (boiling over). Decoys (decoy: true) are happy moments that look a bit like a spark — cues from notes, hop, cheer, glow — and want the All good! button. lead: seconds before the first clue (0.5-4). pace: clue spacing (0.7-1.3; lower = faster). calm: what they say once they've cooled down (short).
